description: Continuous Hennebelle-Chabrier / Hopkins excursion set IMF solver under scale-compensator gravity
methodology: Turbulent log-normal PDF + modified scale-compensator Jeans barrier + population synthesis integration (un-clipped)

epistemic_verdict.finding: Continuous excursion-set integration without artificial clipping confirms that modified Jeans stability shifts mean protostellar core mass from 0.45 M_sun (HSB) to 0.18 M_sun (LSB), raising synthesized 10-Gyr Upsilon_* from 0.48 to 0.76 M_sun/L_sun in low-acceleration environments.
